_help: Kooper's PM64 sprite rows on c_kameki, part by part. F<n>: the field sprite's (WorldKooper) animation n; B<n>: the battle sprite's (BattleKooper); as pm64_partner_pc.c's kAnims and kBattleRows number them. One step key per sprite frame at the sprite's own frame times (60 fps). Features, burnt recolour: local-docs/poses/kooper.md, Engine asks. Our poses; no ROM or disc data.
